note: Silent development timing only. Cue frames are editorial estimates, not Whisper measurements. Fresh narration, actual word timestamps and source/capture review are required in a later authorized wave. Every operational transition is a hard cut (zero overlap).

beats.headline: Remedial Action
beats.body: From a recorded failure to a verified correction.

beats.headline: Start with the Home banner
beats.body: Remedial actions needing follow-up appear on Home. Select the banner to open Follow-ups.
beats.emphasis: REMEDIAL ACTIONS AWAITING FOLLOW-UP
beats.narration: On Home, remedial actions needing follow-up appear in the Remedial actions awaiting follow-up banner. Select this banner to open Follow-ups and return to the outstanding findings.

beats.headline: Or use Bill of Health
beats.body: Home → Bill of Health → Remedial. Read Cleaning findings and CAPA actions separately.
beats.emphasis: 2 Cleaning open + 5 CAPA due = 7 in this view.
beats.narration: You can also enter through Bill of Health. Open Bill of Health from Home, then select the Remedial row. Read its components separately: here, two cleaning remedials are open and five CAPA actions are due. The total of seven is not a Cleaning-only count.

beats.headline:
Recorded today.
Still needs follow-up.
beats.body: A failed scheduled check satisfies its occurrence. The finding stays open.
beats.emphasis: Recording the failure clears today’s due occurrence. It does not clear the finding.
beats.narration: Recording the failure clears today's due occurrence. It does not clear the finding. The check has been recorded for today; now the finding needs its own follow-up.

beats.headline: Keep the finding facts
beats.body: Grade and reason are required. Action taken and photo evidence are optional in this flow.
beats.emphasis: A record of what was found.
beats.narration: Keep the grade and failure reason from the original Cleaning check. Action taken and photo evidence are optional here. The acknowledgement confirms that the completion was recorded.

beats.headline: Choose CLEANING
beats.body: Use the Cleaning bucket in Follow-ups to focus on Cleaning check findings.
beats.emphasis: CLEANING is selected.
beats.narration: In Follow-ups, choose Cleaning to focus on the cleaning check findings.

beats.headline: Find the original Cleaning check
beats.body: Blue Covers · Premix Area · Major. The source tag, finding reason and action identify the record.
beats.emphasis: Unresolved findings remain in Follow-ups across days.
beats.narration: Find the original Cleaning check. Here, the All bucket and a Blue Covers search locate the Major finding in Premix Area. Unresolved Cleaning findings remain in Follow-ups across days.

beats.headline: Return. Observe. Verify.
beats.body: The responsible person checks the corrected condition before signing off.
beats.emphasis: The button records acceptance; the person supplies the honest recheck.
beats.narration: Before sign-off, a responsible person must return and verify the correction. A site manager or above selects Confirm followed up. The button records acceptance; the person must check the actual condition.

beats.headline: Confirm what you observed
beats.body: Add a truthful follow-up note and a photo when useful. Both are optional.
beats.emphasis: The inner CONFIRM records the verification.
beats.narration: Confirm followed up opens the optional note and photo form. Add a follow-up note and photo when useful, then select the inner Confirm to record the verification.

beats.headline: The open card leaves the queue
beats.body: The same Blue Covers search now returns “No matches”.
beats.emphasis: The original failure stays in the record.
beats.narration: After confirmation, the same Blue Covers search returns No matches. The finding has left the open queue, and its original failure remains in the record.

beats.headline: Now in “Resolved today”
beats.body: Follow-up owed moves from 2 to 1. Resolved moves from 0 to 1. The 19 captures stay recorded.
beats.emphasis: Signing off a failure does not turn it into a pass.
beats.narration: The summary now shows one resolved finding, with one still awaiting follow-up. All nineteen captured checks stay recorded. Expand Resolved today to find Blue Covers. The original failure has been signed off; it has not changed into a pass.

beats.headline: Two acts. One retained record.
beats.body: Capture records the failure. Later verification records the sign-off.
beats.emphasis: Attribution identifies the actor; it is not assignment.
beats.narration: The record retains the original failure and its capture attribution alongside the later verification attribution. Signing off the follow-up does not rewrite the failure as a pass. Attribution identifies who acted; it does not assign the finding to an owner.

beats.headline: Critical has a formal handoff
beats.body: This separate Critical Cleaning case also raised an NCR.
beats.emphasis: The formal NCR continues in its own workflow.
beats.narration: This separate Critical Cleaning failure raised an NCR under the critical-only rule. A Major failure does not take that grade-triggered branch. The NCR continues in its own workflow.

beats.headline:
A different origin.
Its own closure.
beats.body: Daily Cleaning begins with a scheduled occurrence. Inspection Remedials begin with an inspection finding.
beats.emphasis: Both open findings require their own follow-up.
beats.narration: Daily describes the Cleaning finding's scheduled origin, not an expiry. Inspection Remedials have a separate carry-over trail. Neither open finding is cleared just because a new day begins.

beats.headline: Capture, then complete the inspection
beats.body: Record before evidence, severity, category, section or area, and description.
beats.emphasis: SAVE FINDING is local; Sign & Complete uploads the findings.
beats.narration: Capture the before photo and record the severity, category, area and description. Save finding keeps a draft on the device. Complete, then Sign and Complete, uploads the findings and issues the inspection. Then check the shared open queue.

beats.headline: Follow “CARRIES OVER”
beats.body: Bill of Health → Inspection Remedials → Follow-ups → INSPECTIONS → OPEN VERIFY FLOW.
beats.emphasis: Open findings carry over until closed or escalated.
beats.narration: Below Carries over, open Inspection Remedials. In Follow-ups, select Inspections, then Open verify flow. Open and remedied findings remain in the queue across inspection dates and statuses until their own decision closes or escalates them. Use the age badge to see how long a finding has been open.

beats.headline: Age is visibility
beats.body: Within each area, review by severity, then oldest. Age colours help you see accumulated work.
beats.emphasis: No deadline, reminder or automatic escalation is implied.
beats.narration: Within each area, findings sort by severity, then oldest. Age is muted through seven days, amber after seven days and coral after thirty days. These colours do not set an SLA, send a reminder or trigger escalation.

beats.headline: Before. Action. After.
beats.body: Review what was found, what was done, and any after evidence.
beats.emphasis: Required after evidence depends on the parent inspection’s photo mode.
beats.narration: Review the before evidence and description. Read any remedial action logged. In Required mode, Accept asks for an after photo. Attach the after evidence before acceptance. Other modes do not impose that gate. There is no structured owner, due date or SLA.

beats.headline: ACCEPT closes the finding
beats.body: Verify the correction and its evidence before accepting.
beats.emphasis: Closed is an explicit decision.
beats.narration: Attach the required after photo, record the action taken, and verify the correction. Accept closes the finding and records an accepted verification. The Closed tab now shows the verified result.

beats.headline: REJECT returns it to open
beats.body: Reject an unsatisfactory correction. Enter a reason if useful, then CONFIRM REJECT.
beats.emphasis: Rejected is still open for further work.
beats.narration: If the correction is not satisfactory, select Reject. Add the optional reason, then Confirm reject. The decision is recorded and the finding returns to open. Reject is not closure.

beats.headline: NCR is a deliberate handoff
beats.body: For formal escalation: NCR → Escalate to NCR → Escalate.
beats.emphasis: A linked formal NCR now continues separately.
beats.narration: For a finding that needs formal escalation, select NCR to open the Escalate to NCR dialog. Escalate creates and links a formal NCR and marks the finding escalated. Inspection findings do not escalate automatically.

beats.headline: Read the decision trail
beats.body: Recent Closed history preserves the decision and actor. The Bill still shows one Inspection finding open.
beats.emphasis: Rejected findings remain open. Linked NCRs continue separately.
beats.narration: Use the recent Closed view to read the decision history, actor and comment. Its thirty-day window limits this view, not stored history. The final Bill still includes the rejected finding: it remains open and needs its own follow-up.

beats.headline:
Keep the finding
until verified.
beats.body: Record the failure. Verify the correction. Preserve the trail.
